pages.title: Cedar Current Runtime
paragraphs: This manual describes the current Cedar runtime.
CEDAR_RETRY_LIMIT defaults to 6 retries in the current Cedar runtime.
Cedar is maintained by Mira Chen.

pages.title: Cedar Recovery
paragraphs: Cedar Recovery says to stop the worker and restore the journal before restarting.

pages.title: Cedar Audit Retention
paragraphs: The current Cedar retains audit records for 14 days.

pages.title: Cedar Deployment Profiles
paragraphs: | Profile | Reserved memory |
| Cedar compact | 384 MiB |
| Cedar standard | 768 MiB |

pages.title: Cedar Archived Runtime
paragraphs: This historical manual describes retired settings for Cedar; it does not describe the current runtime.
CEDAR_RETRY_LIMIT defaults to 2 retries in the archived Cedar runtime.
Cedar was previously maintained by Rowan Lee.

pages.title: Cedar Archived Audit Retention
paragraphs: The archived Cedar retains audit records for 90 days.
